events.text: Need a ladder to change a ceiling bulb
I’ll ask two awake neighbors who may have a ladder.

events.item: ladder to change a ceiling bulb

events.text: Garage full of tools
Setting up her flat
Hi Sulaiman, do you have a ladder Osama could borrow to change a ceiling bulb?
Hi Asma, do you have a ladder Osama could borrow to change a ceiling bulb?
Yeah — got the 6ft aluminium step ladder in the hall. After 13:00 today works. Need me to bring it up or can Osama carry it?
Hi — I don’t have a ladder, sorry. I can help hold a flashlight or stand under the light while someone on a step stool works, or ask Faisal to help after 13:00. Do you want me to come by later today?
I’ll relay the ladder offer and available help.

Sulaiman can lend you a 6 ft step ladder now and asks whether you’d like him to bring it; Asma can also help with a flashlight. I recommend the ladder rather than a step stool for safer reach—which would you like?
Ladder, please bring it
I’ll arrange the ladder delivery and release Asma.
Please bring the ladder to Osama’s door, 1B, at 13:10. Does that work?
Thank you for offering to help; you’re all set for now.
I’ve asked Sulaiman to bring the ladder to your door, 1B, at 13:10. I’ll let you know when he confirms.
Can do. I’ll bring it to 1B at 13:10. Want me to leave it outside the door or hand it to Osama?
Great — glad it's sorted. If you need anything later today, I can come by after 13:30.
Yes please, go with your recommendation
Sulaiman confirmed the delivery, so I’ll close the request.
Thanks, please hand it to Osama at 1B at 13:10.
Sulaiman will bring the ladder to your door, 1B, at 13:10.
Okay. I’ll hand it to Osama at 1B at 13:10.
